# EDTRpad (Online WordPad)

> EDTRpad is a free, browser-based word processor — an online WordPad — with rich text editing, tables, images, file import/export, and printing. No install required; accounts are optional.

## What is EDTRpad?

EDTRpad is a client-side rich text editor that runs in the browser. It is built on ProseMirror and provides a word-processor experience comparable to Microsoft WordPad — without requiring any software installation. Creating an account is optional and enables cloud sync of documents across devices.

The editor is available at: /pad

## Core Capabilities

- Rich text formatting: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript
- Font family selection (20+ fonts via Google Fonts)
- Font size control
- Text color and highlight color
- Paragraph alignment: left, center, right, justify
- Heading levels: H1–H4
- Bullet lists and numbered lists
- Indent / outdent
- Blockquote
- Inline code and code blocks
- Emoji insertion (searchable picker)
- Horizontal rule / divider
- Page breaks (with correct print behavior)
- Tables: insert via grid picker, add/remove rows and columns, resize cells
- Image insertion: upload, paste, or drag & drop; resize, crop, rotate, flip, align
- Hyperlink insertion (Ctrl+K)
- Find & replace (Ctrl+F)
- Multiple documents with a sidebar (localStorage for guests, cloud for members)

## Import, Export & Print

- Open files: .docx, .txt, .md, .html
- Export as Word (.docx) with formatting preserved
- Export as Rich Text (.rtf)
- Export as HTML
- Export as plain text (.txt)
- Print or save as PDF with configurable page margins (0.5 / 1 / 1.5 / 2 cm)
- Accurate page break rendering in print output

## Technical Stack

- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Editor engine: ProseMirror
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4
- UI components: shadcn/ui (Radix UI)
- Icons: Phosphor Icons
- Print: react-to-print
- DOCX export: docx.js — DOCX import: mammoth
- Image editing: react-advanced-cropper
- Runtime: React 19, TypeScript

## Privacy

Without an account, all document data stays in the user's browser via localStorage and no content is transmitted to any server. With an optional free account, documents sync to the user's private cloud space and are never shared.

## Keyboard Shortcuts

- Ctrl+Z — Undo
- Ctrl+Y — Redo
- Ctrl+B — Bold
- Ctrl+I — Italic
- Ctrl+U — Underline
- Ctrl+. / Ctrl+, — Superscript / Subscript
- Ctrl+Shift+L / E / R / J — Align left / center / right / justify
- Ctrl+K — Insert link
- Ctrl+F — Find & replace
- Ctrl+O — Open file
- Ctrl+S — Save now
- Ctrl+A — Select All
- Ctrl+P — Print
- Tab / Shift+Tab — Increase / decrease indent

## Routes

- / — Landing page
- /pad — The editor application
- /guides — How-to guides and articles
